title: Partycraft Plus
description: A highly customizable party plugin for Velocity networks using Paper‑based backend servers
body:
# Partycraft A highly customizable plugin for Velocity networks with Paper-based backend servers that brings party features to your Network. It’s working with Velocity proxies, has no dependencies, and also supports cross‑world teleportation using MultiverseCore. ## Links Our Web-Platform **BETA** https://pythonapps.org/ ## Other Languages Visit our GitHub page to get explainations in other languages.
These Languages are supported: - English [UK] - Deutsch [DE]
## Features
Cross‑server teleportation Cross‑server teleportation allows party members to follow their leader across multiple servers simply by being part of the party.
Cross-world teleportation Cross‑world teleportation allows you to use the same principle as cross‑server teleportation, just for worlds. This feature requires MultiverseCore.
Member roles Allows you to manage the permissions of your Party members.
GUI-based party management Stop using commands to manage your party, start using a GUI. The GUI can be customized with ItemsAdder.
Public parties Public parties are the solution for everyone who feels alone. Play together with anyone who joins your party, or join other public parties yourself.
Party chat Chat with the members of your Party in a private chat for you.
Statistics system Ever wanted to know how long your party has been running? Me neither — but with ``` /party stats ``` you can find out.
## Installation 1. Place the Paper plugin into the plugin folder of every backend server that should use CubeParty. 2. Place the Velocity plugin into the proxy’s plugins folder. 3. Restart all instances and start your first party. ## Compatible plugins [MultiverseCore - Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/plugin/multiverse-core)
[ItemsAdder - SpigotMC](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/%E2%9C%A8itemsadder%E2%AD%90emotes-mobs-items-armors-hud-gui-emojis-blocks-wings-hats-liquids.73355/) ## Plattforms [Proxy - Velocity](https://papermc.io/downloads/velocity)
[Server - Paper](https://papermc.io/downloads/paper)
``` You can also use forks of PaperMC, you don't have to use the original PaperMC Software. ```
